title: State Notice Period Conventions for Repossession and Collateral Recovery Sale Notices
content:
Company schedule of state conventions for the base sale period of a notice of intent to sell under Repossession and Collateral Recovery. The state is the contract state recorded on the borrower's contract in Retail Installment Contracts; the mailing date is the day the notice is mailed.

**Rule.** Where the contract's state is MN or WI, the base sale period is 12 business days (Monday to Friday) counted from the day after the mailing date, expressed as the calendar days from the mailing date to the last of those business days; where it is CO, IA, KS, MA, ME, MO, SC or WV, the base sale period is 20 calendar days, lengthened by two days when that count ends on a Saturday and by one day when it ends on a Sunday so that the earliest sale date falls on a Monday; in any other state the base sale period is the class minimum notice period in calendar days, as counted.

| Contract state | Base sale period |
|---|---|
| MN, WI | 12 business days (Monday to Friday) from the day after mailing, converted to calendar days |
| CO, IA, KS, MA, ME, MO, SC, WV | 20 calendar days; ending on a Saturday adds two days, ending on a Sunday adds one, so the date falls on a Monday |
| any other state | the class minimum notice period in calendar days |

Weekdays are read from the ordinary calendar (5 January 2026 is a Monday).

## How the business-day count converts (counting illustration only, with a hypothetical count of 3 business days)

A notice mailed on Thursday 5 March 2026: the business days counted are Friday 6, Monday 9 and Tuesday 10 March; the last of them is 10 March, so a 3-business-day count would be 5 calendar days. The notice's own count is 12 business days, converted the same way.

## How the weekend roll works (hypothetical mailing dates)

| Mailing date | 20th calendar day | Earliest sale date |
|---|---|---|
| Wednesday 4 March 2026 | Tuesday 24 March | Tuesday 24 March |
| Monday 2 March 2026 | Sunday 22 March | Monday 23 March |
| Sunday 1 March 2026 | Saturday 21 March | Monday 23 March |
